title: Elev8 Tree Turbine Incycler
description:
Elev8 Tree Turbine Incycler
The Elev8 Tree Turbine Incycler is a hefty piece of glass that produces a high amount of cooling and conditioning. There are two main features to this water pipe. The first being the tree percolator which is where the bulk of the cooling/conditioning is done. Then your vapour travels up through the turbine incycler before hitting its intended destination.
The elev8 Tree Turbine Incycler utilizes a 14mm female glass joint.
Included
1 x Elev8 Tree Turbine Incycler
